products.name: Stormfront Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: Stormfront Three Pack Blister [Dusknoir]
products.note: Two Stormfront packs, a Secret Wonders pack (not simulated), a Dialga or Palkia coin and the cosmos holo Dusknoir promo (DP33). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and Collector's Cache's 'Stormfront Blister Exclusive' titles.

products.name: Stormfront Three Pack Blister [Magnezone]
products.note: Two Stormfront packs, a Secret Wonders pack (not simulated), a Dialga or Palkia coin and the cosmos holo Magnezone promo (DP32). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and Collector's Cache's 'Stormfront Blister Exclusive' titles.

products.name: Stormfront Two Pack Blister [Drifblim]
products.note: One Stormfront pack and one POP Series 7 pack (not simulated) with the cosmos holo Drifblim promo (DP34). Collector's Cache's 'Stormfront Blister Exclusive' title only (low confidence).

products.name: 2008 Fall Collector's Tin [Mewtwo LV.X]
products.note: Three Diamond & Pearl-series packs in the real tin (one each from Diamond & Pearl, Mysterious Treasures and Secret Wonders, plus an EX Power Keepers pack; PokeBeach's tin post excerpt and Collector's Cache titles), opened here as Stormfront packs. Tin not simulated.
